### Install

1. Download **Cursor-Pilot.zip** below and open it.
2. Drag **Cursor Pilot** into **Applications**.
3. Open it. The first time, macOS says it can't check the app, because it isn't notarised yet: click **Done**, then **System Settings › Privacy & Security › Open Anyway**.

Updating? Quit Cursor Pilot, replace the app in Applications, and open it again. macOS may ask for its permissions again after an update.

Needs macOS 15 or later on an Apple Silicon Mac.
